THE allotments speciﬁ ed in the Order No. 298 of 2013 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1830/51 dated 04th October, 2013 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka are vested absolutely in the State and the possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the State under Paragraph (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of powers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39(a) (inserted by Act, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Ranil Wickremesingha, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby divest only the allotment specified in the Schedule 1 below. Ranil Wickremesingha, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
